decisions.decision: W0 stub module keeps the test suite RED at the assertion layer rather than module-not-found
decisions.reason: Assertion-layer failures name the missing contract directly, making the W1 surface explicit

decisions.decision: Fixtures live under tests/fixtures/capsule-routing/base/ with a shared helper (lib/fixture.js)
decisions.reason: Base fixture keeps canonical active/blocked/closed/archived/legacy tasks stable across tests; helper avoids per-test tree reconstruction

decisions.decision: Archive index entries report canonical status (closed) for archived tasks; phase preserved separately as archived
decisions.reason: Canonical lifecycle is active/blocked/closed; archived is a marker for the move, not a lifecycle state

decisions.decision: W3 pack header uses task-route aggregateBlockers via dynamic import with synchronous fallback
decisions.reason: Header must be present even if task-route.mjs fails to load; fallback uses raw STATE fields

decisions.decision: W4 auto-archive is a new command in task-state.mjs (not a replacement for archive)
decisions.reason: Existing archive command has mtime-based dates; auto-archive uses today's date for fresh archives and uses task-route style safety checks

decisions.decision: task-route.mjs is pure read-only; task-state.mjs is the sole write surface for archives
decisions.reason: Single writer makes atomicity, idempotency, and audit easier; task-route becomes a stable read-only derivation layer

decisions.decision: task-state.mjs archiveEligibility delegates to routeArchiveEligibility for canonical status checks, then layers write-side safety rules
decisions.reason: Unified eligibility prevents drift between the read and write surfaces without losing the stricter write-side checks
Single source of truth for index entry shape; eliminates duplicate walk logic

decisions.decision: findArchivedTask requires STATE.json to avoid stale-dir false positives
decisions.reason: A directory without STATE.json is not a successful archive; this prevents idempotency checks from incorrectly reporting already-archived

decisions.decision: auto-archive-session-start.mjs runs in dry-run mode by default
decisions.reason: SessionStart/Stop hooks must never silently mutate; user opts in with --apply

decisions.decision: buildTaskHeader uses a static import with try/catch (not dynamic import with synchronous fallback)
decisions.reason: The previous fallback masked route-layer bugs; the new path keeps the header available when route validation rejects the id, and is simpler to reason about

decisions.decision: TASK_ID_RE relaxed to [a-z0-9]+ to match task-state.mjs
decisions.reason: Test fixtures use ids like task-w3-blocked; keeping the two validators consistent avoids surprising failures in the pack path
